Automatic: benchmark evaluators and tests, harness traces; exact McNemar (resolution) and exact sign tests (F2PF direction), paired-task bootstrap 95% intervals, repository-cluster bootstrap (20,000 resamples) with Holm correction; logistic fit for reading boundary

Harness: Yuj (control vs treatment). Models served locally with llama-server, 4-bit Q4 K XL weights, greedy decoding; one trajectory per task per arm. Criterion: evaluator tests (resolution, F2PF).
- Control + Yuj + Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Verified 20,480: F2PF 28.0%, 43/169 solved; 3,280 turns, 37.8M prompt tokens, 1.3 h. Quality partly; cost works (stops early)
- Treatment + Yuj + Qwen3.6, Verified 20,480: F2PF 49.1%, 72/169 (34:5, p<0.0001); 6,517 turns, 80.7M tokens, 4.6 h. Quality works; cost partly (2x+ work)
- Control / Treatment + Qwen3.6, Verified 43,008: F2PF 53.8% -> 60.1% (p=0.0708); 76 -> 87 solved (p=0.0614). Treatment quality partly
- Control / Treatment + Qwen3.6, Verified 262,144: F2PF 69.0% -> 68.7%; 102 -> 101; treatment 7.2% fewer prompt tokens per turn. Quality works (both); treatment cost works
- Control / Treatment + Qwen3.6, Pro 49,152: F2PF 15.2% -> 32.7%; 31 -> 72/316 (p<0.0001); turns 8,357 -> 25,750; tokens 210.6M -> 657.1M; 5.4 -> 21.8 h. Treatment quality works; cost partly
- Control / Treatment + Qwen3.6, Pro 262,144: F2PF 44.8% -> 44.5%; 101 -> 99. No difference
- Control / Treatment + Qwen3.6, FeatureBench 47,104: F2PF 10.5% -> 19.6% (p<0.0001); 2 -> 3/183; turns 5,281 -> 15,178; tokens 140.3M -> 412.8M; 2.5 -> 14.7 h. Treatment quality partly; cost partly
- Control / Treatment + Qwen3.6, FeatureBench 262,144: F2PF 23.9% -> 30.7% (p=0.00022; repository-level p=0.0963); 5 -> 5. Partly
- Control / Treatment + Devstral 2, Verified 20,480: F2PF 17.2% -> 36.8%; 22 -> 53 (p<0.0001). Treatment works
- Control / Treatment + Nemotron-Cascade 2, Verified 20,480: F2PF 12.0% -> 18.3% (p=0.0169); 16 -> 25 (p=0.0636). Treatment partly
- Control / Treatment + Qwen3.8-27B, Verified 20,480: F2PF 20.4% -> 35.3%; 32 -> 54 (p<0.0001). Treatment works
- Exploratory probes (ablation, 15 tasks, single runs): altered caps/activation never beat frozen settings (e.g. Qwen3.6 caps x0.5 5/15, x2.0 4/15 vs 6-7/15)
- Control-credibility check: untreated Yuj vs mini-SWE-agent v2.2.8 with GPT-5.5 via Codex CLI on 500 Verified tasks: 87.6% outcome agreement (kappa 0.66)

Paired: every task run once under control and once under treatment; same task, model weights, context capacity, tool interface, serving, evaluator, harness code; differ only in one checked-in configuration package. Context windows varied (Verified 20,480 / 43,008 / 262,144; Pro 49,152 / 262,144; FeatureBench 47,104 / 262,144). Baseline: control configuration. Acceptance tests: benchmark F2P tests. Repetitions: 1 greedy trajectory per arm. Human intervention: none. Isolation: no network, no gold patches. Operating point set during earlier development on same benchmark families (not held-out)

Under context pressure treatment beats control on F2PF in all three benchmarks (Verified +21.1 pp [14.1, 28.3], Pro +17.5, FeatureBench +9.1; all p<0.0001) and on resolution on Verified (+29 tasks) and Pro (+41); after Holm (repository level) Verified and FeatureBench resolution not significant. Gains shrink with window size; near zero at 262,144 on Verified and Pro. Transfer: gains for all models (1.5x-2.1x F2PF). Reading boundary stretched 2.21-2.53x. Treatment used 2-6x more turns/tokens/time under pressure

Yes: paired design distinguished configurations under pressure; not under ample context.
